title: Push step-count axis further (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^18->2^17)
description: Halved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2^18 to 2^17 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE from 128 to 64 (grad_accum_steps stays 1) to double optimizer step count again within the fixed 5-min budget, on top of the current baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96, DEPTH=8, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1).
reflection: Clear win: val_bpb 0.978298 vs baseline 0.982306 (~0.4% better), the strongest single-run improvement since the round-0/1 width+batch-size stack. This confirms the step-count trend (2^19 bad -> 2^18 good -> 2^17 better) extends further rather than plateauing at 2^18 as some speculated. Also notable: peak VRAM dropped a lot (33.2GB vs ~64GB baseline) since DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE halved with grad_accum_steps=1, so there's headroom to try 2^16 next (would need DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=32) if the trend keeps extrapolating, or to combine this win with the still-open WEIGHT_DECAY=0.15 bracket next round. I deliberately avoided the 3-way WEIGHT_DECAY=0.15 duplicate (a0/a1/a3 all proposed it) and picked the singly-proposed, higher-expected-value idea instead, given only 9 runs remained in the cell.
